fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The "Quality" sort on `/metagame` and the quality score badge both had a bare `title="Quality"` tooltip (or just the label text for the `<select>` option), giving users no explanation of what "Quality" means.

## What changed

In `shared_web/static/js/metagamegrid.jsx`:
- Line 55: updated the `<span title>` on the quality score badge from `"Quality"` to `"Quality: statistical confidence in win %, accounting for sample size (Wilson lower bound)"`.
- Line 93: added the same `title` attribute to the `<option value="quality">` element in the sort `<select>`, so hovering over the dropdown option also shows the explanation.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — **passed** (all checks passed).
- No unit tests exist for this JSX rendering; the change is purely tooltip text with no logic change.

Fixes #12555
